notes: v488 — fixes Scheduled Fetch, which has never once run. It refused to start unless you had your own EODData key saved, even though the app has taken its data from the server since v382 and the download itself works perfectly well without a key. The switch said ON, went green, and could not fire. It now uses the same test as the download it starts, it no longer waits on a pop-up nobody is there to answer, and it tells you what it is waiting for instead of saying nothing. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
